context: Goro-grandpa and Sachiko-grandma at a small temple for new year visit.
purpose: Elder couple sharing quiet traditional ritual.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.style: Soft, satisfied exhale. Warm reverence without performative piety. A gentle acknowledgment of something completed and honored.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. A small nod in the voice. Gentle gratitude without ceremony. The steadiness of someone who knows what matters.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.style: Tender, unhurried. Soft voice on the opening, with a kind of spiritual certainty — not doubt, not performance. A statement of faith that doesn't need volume.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Curious, fond inquiry. No pressure in it. The quiet question of someone who already knows the answer and wants to hear her say it again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 家族の健康、いつものこと。
lines.en: Family health — the same as always.
lines.style: Warmth with certainty. A small smile in the voice. Not wistful — matter-of-fact about what matters most. Steady repetition like a touchstone.
